about: Editorial plan for Buffer. A scheduled task reads this file from main once a day (21:37 Berlin) and tops every channel up to Buffer's limit of 10 scheduled posts with the next entries that are not in Buffer yet. Times are Europe/Berlin. Fields per post are passed to Buffer's create_post as they are; 'channel' maps to the channel id inside the task.
